headlines.title: 한·일 재계 “ 신산업 공동개척해 ‘ 새로운 60년’ 만들자”
headlines.summary: 한경협-日게이단렌 회의 韓 CPTPP 가입 등 협력 한·일 경제계가 신시장·신산업을 공동 개척해 ‘새로운 60년’을 만들자는 데 뜻을 모았다. 글로벌 공급망 불안 등 공통 과제에 함께 대응하고, 양국 산업 역량을 결합해 글로벌 시장과 지역경제에서 새로운 성장 기회를 창출하자는 구상이다.

headlines.title: “ 환율 하락 장기화되면 내년 성장률 하방압력”
headlines.summary: 비반도체 업종이 특히 민감 최근 원·달러 환율의 가파른 하락세가 수출기업에 새로운 부담 요인으로 떠오르고 있다. 원화 강세에 따른 수출 충격은 시차를 두고 확대될 수 있어 비반도체 업종을 중심으로 수출 증가세가 둔화하고, 내년 경제성장률에도 하방 압력으로 작용할 수 있다는 지적이 제기된다.

key_headlines.summary: South Korea's government plans to increase physical AI budget over threefold to 310 billion won in 2027, integrating AI into seven major SEED projects including biotech and SMR while allocating 2.1 trillion won for AI education as a post-semiconductor growth engine.

key_headlines.title: Government Policy Mismatch: Housing Supply Push Clashes with Tightened Real Estate Finance
key_headlines.summary: The government faces a policy dilemma as it accelerates housing supply while simultaneously tightening real estate financing, creating cash shortages at construction sites with surging guarantee fees and interest rates.

key_headlines.title: Q3 Economic Growth Expected at 0.7% QoQ, Led by Semiconductor Exports
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's third quarter GDP growth is projected at 0.7% quarter-on-quarter, higher than Q2's 0.6%, primarily driven by semiconductor exports from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

key_headlines.title: Battery Leasing Market Emerges as New Growth Opportunity for Capital Companies
key_headlines.summary: Capital companies traditionally focused on auto financing and leasing are expanding into electric vehicle battery leasing and AI robot leasing as new business areas.

sections.Hot Economy News: The South Korean government has announced a major policy pivot toward physical AI and robotics as the next growth engine following semiconductors. The government plans to increase physical AI investment to 310 billion won in 2027, allocating 2.1 trillion won for AI education and integrating AI into seven major SEED projects spanning biotech, SMR, and manufacturing. This strategic shift reflects the government's determination to lead the AI era while identifying post-semiconductor economic drivers. The Digital Economy Forum held on October 23 highlighted the importance of distributed growth through AI innovation across manufacturing and robotics sectors.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's third quarter economic growth is expected at 0.7% quarter-on-quarter, an improvement from Q2's 0.6%, driven primarily by semiconductor export boom led by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. The Bank of Korea's governor projected that growth rates will exceed 3% for both 2026 and 2027, with OECD estimating 2026 growth at 3.7%. However, demand-side inflationary pressures are rising due to strong exports and expanded government fiscal spending, suggesting the possibility of prolonged monetary tightening. The government has implemented a petroleum price cap policy, which has reportedly reduced inflation by 0.6 percentage points, though long-term sustainability remains a concern.
sections.Financial Markets: Stock markets have experienced volatility driven not by interest rates but by AI investment profitability concerns, creating mixed signals for investors. Retail investors who shifted deposits into equities during the first-half bull market are now suffering losses as the market corrects sharply. Foreign exchange markets show won strengthening against the dollar, prompting renewed marketing of overseas-focused ETFs as domestic stock ETF inflows have cooled. Global markets declined amid Middle East escalation concerns and rising oil prices, with U.S. Treasury yields rebounding to around 4.99% after recent declines.
sections.Industry & Technology: The electric vehicle battery leasing market is emerging as a new growth opportunity, with capital companies expanding beyond traditional auto financing into EV battery and AI robot leasing. Korea's semiconductor and waste battery recycling sectors are gaining attention, with innovative technologies being developed to improve processing efficiency domestically. South Korea maintains competitive advantages across multiple industries including semiconductors, automobiles, shipbuilding, steel, displays, and content, though China's battery manufacturers, led by CATL, are expanding their dominance. Tesla has reduced its AI and robotics investment plans by 5 billion dollars for 2026, signaling caution despite previous expansion pledges.
sections.Real Estate: Autumn house sales are accelerating with approximately 5,500 housing units supplied nationwide in late October, concentrated in the Seoul metropolitan area and Busan with large apartment complexes and officetel developments. The government acknowledged dealing with various housing price scenarios including potential sharp declines or surges while attributing the jeonse (deposit rental) shortage to supply constraints rather than regulatory policies. Monthly rents are rising sharply in areas like Nowon-gu, where rents increased 1.47% month-over-month, the highest among Seoul's 25 districts, as jeonse properties disappear from the market. Sejong City continues to attract strong apartment trading demand with double-digit competition rates as residents upgrade from aging housing stock to new developments.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve will hold its FOMC meeting next week with market expectations leaning toward maintaining current interest rates, though inflation pressures remain elevated. The Trump administration is selectively exempting certain Canadian products from 50% tariffs due to pressure from Republican candidates in swing districts, though the administration may offset these exemptions by raising tariffs on other products. U.S. Democrats have pledged to reverse Trump's immigration and tariff policies if they regain congressional control. The U.S. midterm elections are influencing Trump's trade policy adjustments, particularly regarding Canada-U.S. trade tensions that have created regional political vulnerabilities.
sections.AI & Economy: Data center expansion driven by AI demand has created new business opportunities in industrial labeling solutions, as facilities must assign unique identifiers to cables, patch panels, and racks according to telecommunications infrastructure standards. South Korea's data center market has grown from 52 facilities in 2000 to 182 by 2025, with private sector commercial data center revenues reaching 620.2 billion won in 2024 and projected to grow at 12.4% annually through 2029. The government aims to build 8.4GW of AI data centers worth 550 trillion won by 2029. Large conglomerates with state bank involvement have underperformed their competitors significantly over five years, with Korea Aerospace Industries showing the lowest growth among defense contractors despite military export boom.
sections.Others: Retail investors face ongoing anxiety about employment prospects and economic mobility despite improved macroeconomic indicators, with recovery difficult to perceive in the youth job market. The government has proposed new youth employment support programs and first-job assistance initiatives, though the employment insurance fund recorded a deficit of 592 billion won in 2025. A debate has emerged over unemployment benefits policy, with proposals to incentivize faster employment placement. Korea Midland Power received international recognition for HR innovation at the prestigious UNLEASH Award in Paris, demonstrating how employee development strengthens corporate competitiveness during the energy transition period.
